name: polar-bear-skills
title: Claude Skills — themed skill packs for Claude Code and Claude.ai
description: A marketplace of themed Claude Skill (Agent Skill) packs. Each pack bundles SKILL.md skills and shared reference files around one job to be done.

install.claudeAi: Settings → Customize → Skills → Upload skill, using the zips in each pack's install/ folder

license: Free to use inside your company, not for resale.

packs.name: workshop-pack
packs.title: The Workshop Pack
packs.description: 7 Claude Skills for workshops worth the room: intention framing, agenda design, pre-work, facilitator run sheet, live capture, 48-hour synthesis, and the facilitation retro.

resources.description: Format library: openers, alignment, ideation (Crazy 8s, brainwriting 6-3-5, SCAMPER, assumption reversal, mash-ups, idea box, worst-possible-idea, analogy storming), convergence, decision, and closing exercises, each with timing, group size, materials, facilitation script, and failure mode.

skills.name: intention-framer
skills.summary: Turns "we should run a workshop" into a real outcome worth a room, or concludes honestly that it should be an email.
triggers: I need to plan a workshop
we're thinking about a team session

skills.name: agenda-designer
skills.summary: Designs the workshop arc: blocks, exercises, timeboxes, group splits, and the energy curve.

skills.name: pre-work-drafter
skills.summary: Drafts the invitation, pre-read, come-with ask, and the facilitation team's briefing.

skills.name: run-sheet-builder
skills.summary: Builds the facilitators pack: run sheet with transition scripts and wobble plans, worksheets, canvases, room and tools plan.

skills.name: live-capturer
skills.summary: Structures post-it walls, flipcharts, board exports, and transcripts while memory is fresh.
triggers: here are the photos of the walls

skills.name: synthesis-writer
skills.summary: Writes the participant follow-up and the full synthesis within 48 hours of the session.

skills.name: workshop-retro
skills.summary: Runs the facilitation team's debrief and writes the retro note the next agenda reads.

packs.name: review-cycle-pack
packs.title: The Annual Review Cycle Pack
packs.description: 11 Claude Skills that run an annual performance review cycle without performance software: cycle planning, growth matrix, review forms, self-reviews, manager growth memos, 1:1 prep, and the end-of-cycle retro.

resources.description: Blank team context file: who is on the team, roles, tenure, context every skill reads. Filled in by cycle-planner.
Blank levels-and-competencies matrix. Filled in by growth-matrix-builder, used by every role.
Blank one-pager on strategy, client signals, and where the market is going. Refreshed each cycle by cycle-planner.
Blank self-review and manager review form. Filled in by review-form-builder.
Ships complete: the question bank managers draw on for 1:1s and review conversations.

skills.name: cycle-setup
skills.summary: Guided setup: which Project to create, which files to add, and a test run of the first skill. Everyone runs this first.

skills.name: cycle-planner
skills.summary: Builds the cycle calendar, team-context.md, and this year's company-direction.md.

skills.name: growth-matrix-builder
skills.summary: Drafts a v1 growth matrix: levels and competencies, and what each one actually looks like.

skills.name: review-form-builder
skills.summary: Creates the self-review and manager review forms, eight questions maximum.
triggers: what should we ask in reviews

skills.name: comms-drafter
skills.summary: Writes the kickoff memo, the manager briefing, every reminder, and the wrap-up, in your tone.

skills.name: cycle-retro
skills.summary: Closes the cycle and turns what happened into next year's improved plan.
triggers: what should we change next year

skills.name: review-prepper
skills.summary: One session per direct report: the evidence sheet and the forward-looking growth memo.
triggers: I need to write reviews for my team

skills.name: one-on-one-companion
skills.summary: Briefs a manager before every conversation, the weekly 1:1 and the review conversation alike, and digests the transcript afterwards.
triggers: I'm meeting Maria in an hour

skills.name: brag-doc-keeper
skills.summary: Logs an employee's wins during the year, so review season has material.
triggers: add this to my brag doc
note what I did this week

skills.name: self-review-prepper
skills.summary: Interviews an employee about their year and drafts the self-review with them.
triggers: I don't know what to write about my year

skills.name: growth-navigator
skills.summary: Reads the growth matrix with the employee, finds their aspiration, and builds a personal growth profile.
triggers: what does the next level mean
help me figure out where I want to grow

packs.name: editing-pack
packs.title: The Editing Pack
packs.description: 3 Claude Skills for making writing better without making it sound generated: diagnosing the shape of a draft, cutting line by line, and rewriting in the writer's own voice.

resources.description: The house rules all three skills read: the defaults (say the thing, concrete over abstract, no corporate throat-clearing, hedge once, short words win), rhythm, formatting, what never gets touched, and the final check.

skills.name: structure-doctor
skills.summary: Diagnoses and fixes the shape of a document: what comes first, what is buried, what should not be there at all.
triggers: what order should this be in

skills.name: line-editor
skills.summary: Edits prose line by line, cutting what does not earn its place without changing the writer's meaning.

skills.name: voice-matcher
skills.summary: Learns how someone writes from a sample and rewrites text in that voice.
triggers: this sounds like AI wrote it
